text: A call from Allah to all mankind: that you worship Allah who has nurtured you with His blessings, and fear Him and do not oppose His religion; for He brought you into existence from nothing, and brought into existence those before you; so that you may be among the righteous whom Allah is pleased with and they are pleased with Him.
